items.title: SoundCloud cracks down on ‘AI slop, spam, and excessive uploads’ – weeks after striking AI deals with Moises and ElevenLabs
items.excerpt: SoundCloud CEO Eliah Seton's open letter updates Community Guidelines and Terms of Use to combat AI slop, spam and excessive uploads, with payout recovery among penalties, while defending the platform's new AI partnerships with Moises and ElevenLabs.
items.note: Related SoundCloud CEO AI-policy Q&A (Billboard) published 11-19; this is the enforcement/terms angle.

history_match.title: SoundCloud CEO Talks AI Policies: 'Wishing Away the Advent of AI Music Is Not a Strategy'

items.title: 5 things to know about Suno’s move into AI video, the DistroKid documents, and the fight over v6
items.excerpt: MBW rounds up Suno's week: the Visuals AI-video tool, DistroKid handing AI-detection documents to UMG and Sony, and the labels' fight to bring Suno's v6 models into the litigation.
items.note: Suno saturated per planner (only product/ruling/deal); roundup — low priority.

history_match.title: Universal and Sony fight Suno's bid to freeze second lawsuit, warning its latest AI models could escape scrutiny until 2028

items.title: TikTok Rolls Out a Manual AI Detection Tool for Users, Officially Launches ‘Likeness Detection’ for Global Creators
items.excerpt: TikTok launched a public AI-content checker for users and rolled out Likeness Detection globally, letting creators and artists find and remove videos that use their likeness without consent.
items.note: Same story also at MBW (11-23). Check marketing/gadgets sections for cross-section dup before roll.

items.title: Universal Music Lambasts ‘Walled Garden’ Criticism as ‘A Complete Flip of Reality’
items.excerpt: At Morgan Stanley's TMT conference, UMG digital chief Michael Nash defended the label's 'walled garden' approach to licensed AI music platforms and outlined superfan D2C plans.

items.title: “They stole a decade of my life and my effort and €230,000 from my pocket”: El Estepario Siberiano threatens legal action against AI scalpers
items.excerpt: Drummer El Estepario Siberiano says AI copycat accounts reskinning his videos have cost him €230,000 and is weighing legal action; he recommends creators use Atlantic's AI Watchdog tool.
items.note: Legal action threatened + named detection tool (passes 'deepfake denial' bar).

items.title: “If you can’t defeat it, you have to join it”: Peter Gabriel makes his stance on AI clear
items.excerpt: Peter Gabriel reaffirms his AI-aligned vision of music's future, arguing artists must engage with the technology rather than resist it.
items.note: Artist opinion — planner says saturated (Bellamy 11-23); low priority.

items.title: sonicLAB Updates SSNN With Neural Buffer FM, Expanded Network Controls
items.excerpt: sonicLAB's SSNN 2.0, an audio processor built on a live 960-neuron spiking neural network driving eight synthesis engines, adds Neural Buffer FM, more network controls and four voice outputs.
items.note: Neural synthesizer — different product from Anukari/Neutone.

items.title: AI is being used to clone real people's videos
items.excerpt: BBC Verify finds musicians, comedians and dancers having their videos 'reskinned' with AI-generated characters by copycat accounts that monetise the clones.
items.note: Pairs with El Estepario / Sophie Lloyd (Louder, off-list) AI reskin stories.

items.title: WMG and Spotify talk AI remixes and the need for artist consent
items.excerpt: At Morgan Stanley's TMT conference, Warner Music Group and Spotify executives said Spotify's AI remix tool is waiting on artist consent frameworks before user testing.
items.note: Spotify remix tool in prep covered 11-21 (DMN) — status update only.

history_match.title: Spotify Reportedly Set to Debut AI Cover & Remix Tool in Early '27

items.title: Agentic AI in music marketing: ‘superhumans’, safeguards and 7am inbox briefs
items.excerpt: Music Ally examines how music marketers are using agentic AI that breaks tasks into steps across inboxes, spreadsheets and ad platforms, and the safeguards teams are adding.

items.title: 정부, AI 학습용 저작물 거래 기준 만든다…26일 공청회
items.excerpt: 문화체육관광부가 26일 'AI 학습을 위한 저작물 이용허락 표준계약서(안)' 공청회를 열어 AI 학습용 저작물의 범위·이용기간·이용료 산정 방식 등 거래 기준을 공개한다.
items.note: Korean government AI-training licensing standard contract (applies to music).

items.title: "감귤·AI·케이팝 만났다"…제주도 홍보 영상 공개
items.excerpt: 제주도가 작사·작곡부터 노래와 영상까지 전 과정을 생성형 AI로 만든 케이팝 음악영상 '노지(NOZY) - 제주 주얼(JEJU JEWEL)'을 공개했다.
items.note: AI music video, fully generative K-pop promo.

items.title: Windchime: an Audiovisual Installation with Audio-Language Model implementations
items.excerpt: An audiovisual installation where spoken prompts are embedded by an audio-language model to retrieve from 406 artist-authored stems and live-coded Strudel fragments, alongside interactive Three.js scenes controlled via monome grid and arc.
